user.title: Adaptive Heating
user.description: Rooms are the Areas with a heater labelled heating.

heater_drew_nothing.title: Heater drawing nothing
heater_drew_nothing.description: {room} is switched on and drawing no power.

relay_stuck_closed.title: Relay stuck closed
relay_stuck_closed.description: {room} is drawing power with the relay open.

thermostat_drew_power.title: Thermostat drawing power
thermostat_drew_power.description: {room} is drawing power while switched off.

warm_room_by.name: Warm the room to a temperature by a time
warm_room_by.description: Starts the room early enough to be at the temperature by the time given, and runs at full output until it is there.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: The temperature the room is to reach.

by_time.name: Wanted by
by_time.description: When the room is to be at that temperature. A time alone means the next time it comes round.

hold_temperature.name: Hold the room at a temperature until it expires
hold_temperature.description: Holds the temperature for the time given, then falls back to the room's target.

set_warming_rate.name: Set how fast the room warms
set_warming_rate.description: The rate the room works backwards from when it is given a deadline.

measured_at_outdoor.name: Measured at
measured_at_outdoor.description: The outdoor temperature that rate was measured at.

set_regulation.name: Set how the room is regulated
set_regulation.description: The numbers the room's loop runs on until it is given others.

behaviour.name: Holding behaviour
behaviour.description: Paced runs a fraction of each cycle. A plain band switches at the edges.

band.name: Band
band.description: How far the room may drift either side of its target. Setting it locks it.

outdoor_shift_per_degree.name: Outdoor shift
outdoor_shift_per_degree.description: Extra output per degree the target sits above the outdoor temperature.

cycle_length.name: Cycle length
cycle_length.description: How long one paced cycle lasts.

full_output_below.name: Full output below
full_output_below.description: How far below target the room runs flat out.

shortest_time_between_relay_changes.name: Shortest time between relay changes
shortest_time_between_relay_changes.description: Protects the relay's contacts. It overrides the band.

switched.name: Switched
switched.description: On or off for a room with no temperature reading. Its own dial holds the temperature.

sensor_freshness.name: Sensor freshness
sensor_freshness.description: How long a reading stays usable.

stuck_reading.name: Stuck reading
stuck_reading.description: How long a flat reading may stand before it is left out.

sensor_spread.name: Sensor spread
sensor_spread.description: How far a reading may sit from the others in its room.

freshness_record_retention.name: Keep sensor records for
freshness_record_retention.description: How long a quiet sensor is remembered.

heaters.name: Heaters
heaters.description: This room's heaters. Replaces what was discovered.

temperature_sensors.name: Temperature sensors
temperature_sensors.description: This room's sensors. Replaces what was discovered.

window_sensor.name: Window sensor
window_sensor.description: Heating stops while this says open.

neighbour.name: Borrow the reading from
neighbour.description: Used only where the room has no sensor of its own.

outdoor_sensor.name: Outdoor sensor
outdoor_sensor.description: Sets how hard the room fires while it holds.

frost_temperature.name: Frost temperature
frost_temperature.description: What a thermostat underneath is set to while the room runs without a reading and rests between heats.

frost_limit.name: Frost limit
frost_limit.description: Off leaves only the thermostat's own lowest setting.

return_to_target.name: Return the room to its target
return_to_target.description: Ends any warm-up and any timed hold. The room holds the temperature it was last set.

move_to_area.name: Move the room to another area
move_to_area.description: The room keeps its thermostat, its history and what it has learnt, and finds its heaters in the new area. Refused where another room is already there.

area.name: Area
area.description: The area the room moves to.

set_labels.name: Set the labels that find the rooms
set_labels.description: Which label a heater carries to make its area a room, and which label keeps an entity out. Sent by the add-on from its House tab.

include_label.name: Include label
include_label.description: The label id a heater or temperature sensor carries. Empty finds every one.

exclude_label.name: Exclude label
exclude_label.description: The label id that keeps an entity or an area out, whatever else it carries.
